g.text: All 51 islands: contributions to the later-record prediction gain

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233a43

g.text: Each bar contributes to the overall MSE reduction. Positive bars improve the score; negative bars worsen it.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233a43

g.text: Labels: landmass ID · smallest-ID example port [sampled-port country codes]. Port names are not island names.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233a43

g.text: Rows are ordered by the saved circuit increment, with numeric-ID tie breaking. All adverse contributions remain visible.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53656d

g.text: These are descriptive contributions from pair predictions, not port-specific effects, local abundance or independently validated geographic drivers.
